correctness.rationale: Explicit normal form for all rank-one idempotents gives \(bc=a(1-a)\). For \(a\notin\{0,1\}\), the scalar \(aI\) is a polynomial in the generators, and the corner generators produce precisely a conjugate of \(M_2(\mathbb F_p(a))\); the degenerate values have a common invariant line and cannot generate. Frobenius Möbius inversion and independent \(q(q+1)(q-1)\)-element orbit sizes yield exact counts. Direct exhaustive ring-closure verification succeeded for all ordered rank-one pairs over \(\mathbb F_q\) with \(q\in\{2,3,4,5,8,9\}\). The characteristic-two and binary boundaries are proved.

value.rationale: Determines a canonical exact random finite-matrix-ring generation probability under the nonlinear idempotent constraint, together with complete subfield-size strata and a geometric conjugacy-orbit classification; distinguishes genuine ring generation from field-algebra generation. The field-degree constraint is essential for nonprime fields: \(\mathbb F_9\) has 720 ordered idempotent pairs generating only a conjugate of \(M_2(\mathbb F_3)\) as a unital ring although they generate as an \(\mathbb F_9\)-algebra, compared with 4320 full-ring generating pairs. This is a natural exact enumerative invariant over an infinite family.
